hero.subtitle: Your notes live in a Markdown vault on your own server, reachable from any browser with sync built in, while an AI agent keeps them filed, tagged and linked. Mino is an open-source Obsidian alternative, and you bring the model key. Join the list and you get one email when it launches.

features.label: WHAT IT DOES
features.title: Built for people with
features.subtitle: What the server and the agent do, one card each.

smartImport.title: Import that ends in Markdown
smartImport.description: Drop in a web page or a PDF. The agent converts it to Markdown, gives it a title and files it where it belongs.

aiOrganization.title: The agent keeps it sorted
aiOrganization.description: It reuses the tags you already have, links a note to related ones, writes summaries and keeps the folder tree shallow.

intelligentRetrieval.title: Search, then answers
intelligentRetrieval.description: Full-text search works with no setup. Add embeddings and it searches by meaning; answers arrive with the notes they came from.

selfHosted.title: One container, your files
selfHosted.description: The vault is a folder of plain .md files on a server you run, so Obsidian or any editor can open it too. No account and no export step.

agentNative.title: Built around the agent
agentNative.description: Every note operation is an HTTP route with an X-Mino-Key header, plus an MCP bridge, so the agent and your own tools work in the same vault.

everywhere.title: Reach it from anywhere
everywhere.description: Your server is the sync. Open the vault from any browser through the relay or your own tunnel; the Android and iOS builds are in development.

howItWorks.label: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.title: Follow one note
howItWorks.subtitle: Capture is the only step you have to do. The agent handles the filing; search handles the rest.

step1.title: Capture it
step1.description: Write Markdown, drop in a web page, import a PDF. The note is a plain .md file from the moment it lands.

step2.title: The agent files it
step2.description: It reads the note, reuses your existing tags, links it to related notes and moves the file where it belongs.

step3.title: Find it again
step3.description: Full-text search is on by default. With a provider configured it turns semantic, and the agent answers from your notes.

agent.label: THE AGENT
agent.title: What the agent
agent.subtitle: It works inside the vault, proposes a place for what you save, and reports every change it makes.
agent.chatMsg1: I found 3 notes about "architecture" that aren't linked. Want me to connect them and write an index note?
agent.chatMsg2: Yes, and tag them with #core-systems too
agent.chatMsg3:
Done:
• Linked all 3 architecture notes
• Created MOC-Architecture.md
• Added #core-systems to each
• Found 2 more related notes in /Research
agent.capability1Desc: Reads the note and applies tags that exist in your vault.
agent.capability2Desc: Finds the notes a new one belongs with and links them.
agent.capability3Desc: Writes an index note that lists what a topic contains.
agent.capability4Desc: Answers a question from many notes and links the ones it used.
